description: Amplitude Identify API on /identify. Amplitude documents api_key and identification as required, on the query for GET or as form fields for POST. HTTP V2 events are vendor/amplitude. Group identify is vendor/amplitude-group-identify.

params.name: api_key
params.description: It is the project API key. Amplitude documents it as required on GET query and POST form.
params.fix_hint: Send `api_key` with the Amplitude project API key.

params.name: identification
params.description: It is a JSON identification object or array. Amplitude documents it as required. Each object needs user_id or device_id.
